messages:
alex: Starting a short thread to finalize the release notes for the upcoming docs push (v0.11.0 target). I opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — want concise bullets + migration callouts.
sara: I'll add the SDK snippet updates (py/js) and a 1-line migration note for the streaming default change. Keep snippets tiny, focused on the callsite.
jamie: FYI I ran into a regression in our internal test when `streaming` default flipped to true; I'll paste a minimal repro in the PR comments. We should list that under Known Issues with mitigation (set streaming=false).
morgan: Doing a link sweep now. Found one dead anchor in guides/gradual-rollout.md and a stale gist URL in examples/prefix-cache.md. I'll push fixes to the branch.
alex: Good. Snacks: TL;DR line for announcement (one sentence). Also add a short note for Dedicated customers about canary rollout and fallback behavior.
sara: TL;DR candidate: "v0.11.0 — improved streaming, smarter batching heuristics, and small SDK tweaks (see migration note)."
jamie: Adding Known Issue: embeddings 429 under high concurrency when Dedicated burst is enabled. Minimal repro: `wrk -t10 -c200 -d45s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` — you'll see 429s after ~30s. Mitigation: add client-side retry/backoff or route to non-burst pool.
morgan: Also adding a tiny prefix-cache example to samples (2 lines). Example: `client.enable_prefix_cache('my-cache')` — happy to expand if we need more.
docs-bot: CI queued: link-check, snippet-lint, and build. Expect results in ~6m.
alex: If CI passes, I'll merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and send announcement. Assign reviewers: @sara @jamie. Please add review comments by EOD. :thumbsup:
sara: Ok added py/js snippet pair and a brief migration table. Keeping examples short per guidance.
jamie: Left a note about rollout schedule for Private deployments (staged over 48h).
morgan: Link-check passed locally; pushing the two anchor fixes now.
docs-bot: CI: snippets: OK, link-check: OK, build: OK.
alex: Great — final signoff: merge at 09:00 PT if no objections. Thanks everyone. :tada:
